title: Bits of the block code
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates with width at most $w$, let $P$ be a set of its literal positions, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The block code formed from $T$, $P$, and $x$ has, at the embedded position of every $j\in P$, the bit of $x$ at the coordinate of the $j$th literal, adjusted by the inverse sign encoding of that literal's required sign.
hypotheses_covered: A term T on n coordinates
The width of T is at most w
A set P of literal positions
An assignment x in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
